name: Love Bites
source:
You play as a werewolf named Gabe at Duskhollow University! Gabe is an overachiever and excels in most of his classes, and he takes great pride in this.

On the other hand, Luka is a charming yet unambitious vampire. 

When the two are forced to work on a project together,  a chance for romance to bloom between the unlikely pair arises.

[Edited from [url=https://xmangosagox.itch.io/love-bites]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在暮谷大学扮演一个名叫加布的狼人！加布（Gabe）成绩优异，在大部分课程中都表现出色，他对此感到非常自豪。

另一方面，卢卡是一个迷人但没有野心的吸血鬼。

当两人被迫一起完成一个项目时，这对不太可能的情侣之间出现了浪漫绽放的机会。

[编辑自[url=https://xmangosagox.itch.io/love-bites]itch.io[/url]]
